name: Weapon Master
body:
Feat Selection

The weapon master dragoon style’s feat selection are as follows: weapon focus, greater weapon focus, weapon specialization, greater weapon specialization, and any weapon mastery feat.

Dragoon Style

At 2nd level, the dragoon selects a single fighter weapon group. All feats which require them to select a single weapon instead apply to all weapons in this fighter weapon group.

Improved Dragoon Style

At 6th level, the dragoon’s training with their chosen weapon group deepens. They gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with weapons in their selected group. This bonus increases to +2 if they already have Weapon Focus and Weapon Specialization with a weapon from that weapon group.

This does not stack with the bonus from the fighter’s weapon training, the higher bonus is instead used.

Greater Dragoon Style

At 11th level, the dragon adds their Charisma modifier (minimum +1) as a bonus on confirmation rolls for critical hits and to their CMD against disarm and sunder attempts.

Master Dragoon Style

At 17th level, once per day the dragoon can make a single attack roll with a weapon from their chosen weapon group and so long as they hit they can choose to treat the attack as if they had rolled a critical hit (they still need to roll to confirm) and this must be declared before rolling the attack roll.

In addition when a dragoon lands a natural 20 on their attack roll and confirms the critical hit they no longer automatically fail on a roll of natural 1 until the end of their next turn.
